POST /v1/knowledge/query accepts the allowlisted Wikidata P36 property; GET /v2/query routes 'capital of <entity>' and possessive forms to capital relationships; up to three ranked entity matches and non-deprecated relationship statements are preserved with time qualifiers, and source data is not presented as a Lean proof

POST /v1/knowledge/query accepts allowlisted Wikidata P37 official language and P38 currency; GET /v2/query routes official-language and currency intents through these properties; up to three ranked entity candidates are preserved with claim rank, qualifiers, and references where available; bounded process-local response cache; results are retrieved source data, not Lean proofs

D[ArcTan[f(x)],x] supports bounded expressions in the real calculus grammar; indefinite Integrate supports ArcTan[x] and 1/(1+x^2) when Lean checks the resulting HasDerivAt proof; any generated domain conditions are returned in evidence

Lean-checked ArcSin and ArcCos derivatives for bounded real expressions with explicit strict argument bounds -1 < argument < 1; out-of-range constant inputs are rejected rather than treated as real-valued

Lean-checked ArcSinh, ArcCosh, and ArcTanh derivatives; indefinite integrals for 1/Sqrt[1+x^2], ArcSinh[x], 1/Sqrt[x^2-1], ArcCosh[x], and 1/(1-x^2); ArcCosh requires argument > 1 and ArcTanh requires -1 < argument < 1; generated positivity and denominator conditions are reported in evidence.domain_conditions

Lean-checked Tanh derivatives for bounded real compositions and indefinite Integrate[Tanh[x],x] when SymPy proposes log(cosh(x)); the proof derives cosh nonzero from positivity, so no false domain condition is returned

Lean-checked Coth derivatives for bounded real compositions with explicit Sinh[argument] != 0 pole conditions; indefinite Integrate[Coth[a*x+b],x] for rational nonzero a returns log(Abs[Sinh[a*x+b]])/a when Lean checks the HasDerivAt certificate; generated domain conditions are returned in evidence.domain_conditions

Lean-checked Sech and Csch derivatives for bounded real compositions; Sech uses Real.cosh positivity to prove its denominator nonzero without exposing a condition, while Csch returns the explicit Sinh[argument] != 0 pole condition; antiderivatives remain unsupported
Lean-checked Sqrt derivatives require a positive variable argument; selected antiderivatives such as Integrate[1/Sqrt[x],x] return explicit positivity and denominator conditions

D[Log[base,argument],variable] and selected indefinite Integrate[Log[base,argument],variable] cases support a statically rational base greater than zero and different from one; the real argument positivity condition is explicit, and Lean proves the logarithm of the base is nonzero; variable bases and definite explicit-base logarithm integrals remain unsupported
